audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[4/5/6].side read 'Skill' while both the packet chart and content win[4/5/6] read Azir, so the last three rows of the level chart rendered two different answers.
audit.why: packet.levelChart = Skill/Skill/Azir/Skill/Azir/Azir/Azir and content win[] is identical; only the full layer differed. The three full-layer whys already argued Azir wins those stages.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side, phases[5].side, phases[6].side -> Azir with all three whys rewritten around Veigar's actual limits (no dash, 725 cage, 650 ult range).

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text named the first-item spike as 'Liandry's/Shard' — 'Shard' is not an item Azir builds and the itemization section says Nashor's Tooth.
audit.why: Defect catalogue item 7: name the real item or drop the clause. report[8].t: 'Nashor's Tooth rush into Sorcerer's'.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text now names Nashor's Tooth and keeps the point that it lands while his Phenomenal Evil stacks are still low.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. (a) content.early said 'Baleful Strike (Q) resets on kill/assist near enemies' — the Q has no reset; what it does is grant permanent AP for units it kills. (b) The page never stated the one interaction that decides the matchup: Event Horizon stuns whatever passes THROUGH it, and Shifting Sands is a dash, so dashing out of the cage stuns you. The old text gestured at 'never dash into the wall' without saying your own E is the dash in question.
audit.why: Enemy kit Q: 'Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently', 6/5.5/5/4.5/4, 1000 range. Enemy kit E Event Horizon: 20/18.5/17/15.5/14, 725 range, 'creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through'. Owner kit E is a dash, 22s at rank 1. Enemy kit P: striking a champion with a spell grants permanent AP.
audit.corrected: content.early rewritten with the real Q behaviour and numbers; breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and loading now spell out that your own dash through the cage edge is a stun; the passive's permanent-AP-on-spell-hit is now the reason given for dodging in tldr and breakdown.feeding.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no digit — only 'matchup-defining' and 'check it before every step-up'.
audit.corrected: Now carries Event Horizon 20s/14s and 725 range, Baleful Strike 6s/4s, Primordial Burst 120s scaling on missing health.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string pasted verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string pasted verbatim, neither answering its title. dontsFull[1].d quoted nineteen seconds for Shifting Sands (rank 1 is 22s). wants.you[1] claimed Shifting Sands can 'block skillshots'.
audit.why: Defect catalogue items 2 and 6. Owner kit E shields Azir himself; nothing in the text blocks projectiles.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to their titles, 22s used, and wants.you[1] reduced to the escape the kit actually supports.

edits.before: - Veigar Event Horizon (Cage): matchup-defining — Only the cage EDGE stuns — hold position near the center or leave before it forms; never dash into the wall. Check it before every step-up. - E Shifting Sands is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Event Horizon (E) is 20s at rank 1, 14s at rank 5, and 725 range — it stuns anything that passes through the edge, so a Shifting Sands dash out of the cage stuns you. - Baleful Strike (Q) is 6s at rank 1 and 4s at rank 5. - Primordial Burst (R) is 120s at rank 1 and scales with your missing health.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are close to even — Veigar's Baleful Strike (Q) resets on kill/assist near enemies and both champs can farm safely from range, but the moment he lands even a partial cage combo it hurts, so treat this as a skill matchup rather than a free lane. By Level 3 your extra soldier and range start winning trades outright as long as you respect his Event Horizon threat range and don't dash into a walled area blind.

notes: Dark Matter's cooldown is listed as 0 in the kit file, which is a parse artifact of 'Stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce Dark Matter's cooldown' — I therefore never quoted a number for his W anywhere, only its behaviour (delayed meteor, lands where you are standing). Level chart: only the full layer disagreed (Skill on rows 4-6 against Azir in both the packet and the content layer), so the full layer moved to them with whys rewritten. phases[].rating left untouched. The permanent-AP-on-spell-hit half of Phenomenal Evil Power was not on the page at all and is now the stated reason to dodge; I attributed the last-hit AP specifically to Baleful Strike, since Riot's text ties it to units killed by that bolt rather than to CS generally.
